subject: Request: evidence & timeline for temporary processor swap and DPA addendum
messages:
From: Malini Roy <m.roy@acmepay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: AcmePay Security <security@acmepay.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: temporary processor swap + DPA addendum

Hi Karthik,

We received notice that Redwood intends to route a subset of telemetry/observability traffic through a temporary third-party processor next month. Before we can approve the change for our account (AcmePay), the security and privacy teams need a short package with the following:

- The exact subprocessor(s) being added (formal name + country).
- Scope of processing (what data fields, retention windows, access controls).
- Network/data flow diagram showing onshore/offshore mirroring and egress points (PDF).
- Evidence the temporary processor is SOC2-type assessed or under reasonable compensating controls.
- Planned start and end dates for the temporary routing and rollback plan.
- A proposed DPA addendum covering the temporary processor (we will need explicit deletion/export guarantees).

Can you provide these items and a conservative timeline by EOD Monday PST? If Redwood plans to do onshore mirroring for AcmePay specifically, call that out — we need to confirm residency controls for cardholder-adjacent logs.

If it helps, we can open a short intake ticket and schedule a 30-minute call next week to review.

Thanks — Malini
Malini Roy
Senior Manager, Security Risk
AcmePay Inc.
malini.roy@acmepay.com
security@acmepay.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Malini Roy <m.roy@acmepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: temporary processor swap + DPA addendum

Hi Malini — thanks for the clear list.  Appreciate the heads-up.

Short summary / next steps from our side:
- Processor: "EdgeBridge Analytics LLC" (US-based) — preliminary manifest attached (subprocessor_manifest.csv).
- Scope: telemetry (service-level logs, anonymized request metadata). No plaintext PII or payment payloads will be routed.
- Planned window: 2026-06-25 00:00 UTC — 2026-07-09 23:59 UTC (14-day pilot). Rollback plan: immediate routing revert + cache purge for affected streams; we will provide export of any retained telemetry.
- Evidence: EdgeBridge has a public security factsheet; we'll provide their SOC2 Type II report redacted for non-public items (will deliver by COB Monday).
- Residency: for AcmePay we will enable onshore mirroring (US-only) for the pilot; European accounts will not be mirrored to EdgeBridge. Network diagram attached (network_diagram.pdf).
- DPA addendum: attaching a Redwood draft addendum (dpa_addendum_draft.docx) — legal will expedite redlines.

Action items we've taken now: cc'ing Laura (privacy lead) and Ben (ops) to confirm retention and rollback steps. We'll upload the assembled package to a secure share and send a link by Monday morning.

If you want a quick sync, Ben can host a 30-minute call Wed 6/16 at 10am PT. Does that work?

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs: subprocessor_manifest.csv (list + countries), network_diagram.pdf (dataflow), dpa_addendum_draft.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: quick DPA addendum and redlines for AcmePay temporary processor

Kimberly — looping you in. AcmePay asked for a short DPA addendum covering a temporary routing to EdgeBridge (US). They require explicit deletion/export guarantees and confirmation of onshore mirroring for their account.

Key asks from AcmePay:
- Explicit date-bounded authorization for the temporary processor (start/end).
- Export and deletion commitments for any telemetry retained by the processor.
- Audit evidence (SOC2 summary or equivalent).
- Confirmation that no cardholder data or full payment payloads will be routed.

Suggested quick redlines (for your draft):
1) Clause limiting scope to anonymized telemetry and service-level logs only; exclude payment payloads.
2) Timebox: add start/end dates + automatic expiry of permission unless mutually renewed.
3) Onshore mirroring addendum: mandatory for AcmePay (US-only routing).
4) Audit access: 30 days to provide SOC2 summary + reasonable cooperation for short security questionnaire.
5) Data return/deletion: processor must return exports and certify deletion within 15 days of pilot end.

We need a tight turnaround — AcmePay asked for the package by EOD Monday PST. Can you draft/redline and I will push to them and share the secure folder? 48-hour turnaround would be ideal.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Malini Roy <m.roy@acmepay.com>
Cc: AcmePay Security <security@acmepay.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: temporary processor swap + DPA addendum

Hi Malini / AcmePay Security team — following up with the package and next steps. Thanks for the patience while we pulled this together.

What we've provided (secure folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeSecureShare
- subprocessor_manifest.csv — EdgeBridge Analytics LLC (US) — processing scope and contact.
- network_diagram.pdf — dataflow showing onshore mirror for AcmePay and egress points.
- dpa_addendum_draft.docx — Redwood's proposed addendum with the requested timebox and deletion language.
- EdgeBridge_Security_Factsheet.pdf (redacted SOC2 summary pending; will follow by COB today).

Pilot window: 2026-06-25 00:00 UTC through 2026-07-09 23:59 UTC.
Mitigations: onshore mirroring enabled for AcmePay, no payment payloads routed, immediate rollback + export/delete within 15 days post-pilot if requested.

Next steps we propose:
1) AcmePay to confirm whether the proposed window and deletion timing are acceptable.
2) If accepted, we schedule a 30-minute call to walk the diagram and DPA redlines (Ben suggested Wed 6/16 10am PT; we are flexible).
3) Legal: please confirm any redlines to the attached addendum (Kimberly copied).

HubSpot intake: HS-11234 (for tracking and approvals).

If you'd rather have a DocuSign route for the addendum or need additional evidence items (e.g., packet capture snapshots, config extracts), say the word and we'll prioritize.

Best regards,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
